nom: Lancôme Crème Mousse Confort Creamy Foaming Cleanser

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: This product is great for make up removal or just to use as a daily cleanser. It has a wonderful clean scent . I love it.

avis.titre: I love love love this product!
avis.texte: I have used this product many years. I've tried others but it's the only cleanser that doesn't leave my face feeling dry.

avis.titre: ￼ This is a must have if you have oily skin
avis.texte: I have really oily skin and this is the only cleanser that I use to moisturize my skin from getting ordered throughout the day and it clears up my dark spots. I would recommend this product over and over.
Have used this for years as my "go-to" cleanser. It never disappoint!
Doesn't take a lot of product to was face. Gentle, but great cleaning.

avis.titre: I will buy this cleanser over and over
avis.texte: Perfect for my 70+ skin. Removes makeup and leaves my skin feeling soft . I have a very dry patch on my cheek that flakes all the time and this has helped to minimize it. I highly recommend this cleanser for anyone with dry skin. It is perfect for your skin
Foamy yet rich. Ideal if you want a soft, soothing clean that's still gentle great for those who love a luxurious texture. Its by far my favorite facial cleanser
Lancôme comfort crème cleanser is a must have. You only need the size of a pea to clean your whole face. It's gentle and effective. The smell is very light and pleasant. It works great !

What I love is that using this cleanser feels very luxurious— like you're pampering your skin for a few minutes of your day! As many have said, a little really does go a very long way so a bottle will last a while which i think is important. After using, add a moisturizer quickly after to avoid any dryness.
I have never enjoyed washing my face more! Cleans well without drying, foams up nicely & I absolutely LOVE the fragrance!
I have used this for 40 years and will definitely continue to use!
Luxurious creamy face wash. Light scent and gentle. Little goes a long way. Rinses clean and my skin felt soft after using it. Pleasantly surprised!

One of the products I buy on repeat. Feels gentle to my skin and have had no issues. Was surprised to read the negative reviews. I like the smell also and the tube lasts me a long time. I use every night except when traveling. Is there a travel size?
Makes my skin feel cleansed and soft. Scent is lovely, not too strong but perfect.
I love this cleanser! It smells great, is super- foamy and smooth. My face feels soft after using.
Both creamy and light, this cleanser really cleans my face while leaving my skin soft.

avis.titre: Has worked wonders on my skin
avis.texte: I'm 40, have combination skin. I triple cleanse & this is the last cleanser I use. I have noticed such an improvement in my skin as far as breakouts & the evenness of my skin. I would highly recommend this product. It's worth every penny
It's so easy to wash your face while in the shower . Use it every day
This cleanser is creamy and leaves my skin feeling soft, clean and refreshed. Hi, would definitely recommend this cleanser!
This product lathers well, and doesn't take a lot to lather. My skin feels smoother and looks refreshing afterwards.
First time using this product. I find the scent and texture to be comforting to my skin. Leaves me feeling refreshed and clean.
Love the texture, smell, and foam lather of this product! 10/10!!

avis.titre: This is the only Lancôme product I don't care for
avis.texte: I really don't like this product. It's takes a lot to get a good lather and I don't like how dry my face is afterwards. I thought it was going to be like the crème radiance cleanser just with a rose element and scent but it is nothing like it. Maybe it's just not for my skin type but I don't like it. I recommend the crème radiance instead
Love this facial wash! This is the only wash that I use! Gentle cleans and leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean.
Love this. Use at night. Helps with my dry skin. No strong smell. Wish it was sold as a travel size
Gentle everyday cleanser, doesn't dry out skin, I have been repurchasing for a few years now, works well
Exactly what my dry/sensitive face needed, it moisturized without leaving it feeling oily.
My face feels fresh hydrated not feeling dry at all love it !!!
It's creamy, soft, and gentle on my sensitive skin and I enjoy it!

avis.titre: The best cleanser, light and slightly perfumed
avis.texte: This cleanser has a lovely, very slight rose scent. It's also rich and creamy. I've been using it for years.

I love Creme Mousse Confort Foaming Cleanser!! Its smell is very comforting and makes me feel relaxed. I use a Japanese foaming net to lather, and it lathers very well with a tiny amount. I highly recommend it!!
I have dry skin and this product suits my skin type perfectly. I've been using this for a year and it has helped to clear and reduce my acne. Thanks Lancome!
Need very little product to work beautifully as an every day cleanser!
I received a sample of this cleanser and had to order full size! Makes my skin feel so soft, doesn't dry it out like some cleansers and smells really nice.
This is a gentle cleaner that will tackle the day's makeup and grime. It lasts a surprisingly long time with daily use. Highly recommended!
Works well, gentle, and leaves my skin feeling very smooth and soft. Removes makeup well.

I've been using Crème Mousse Confort Foaming Cleanser for a month now and I love it. It removes all makeup, oil and buildup without breakouts or irritation, and my skin feels clean but not dry, soft, plump, and hydrated.
This creamy cleanser is a game-changer! It creates a rich, luxurious foam. My skin feels incredibly smooth and radiant after each use.
Amazing cleanser, smells so fresh and clean. Leaves no film, just smooth clean skin.
This is an amazing face. Wash, it leaves my face nice and clean it gently removes all makeup in a single wash. This is definitely my go to face wash of all times
This product is soft and smooth but gets the job done and works really well with Rose honey toner!
I use this face soap daily and it makes me skin feel clean and wonderful!
This cleanser is a dream come true. Really gentle and works wonders. Try it, you'll love it.

avis.titre: Love the Crème Mousse Confort Foaming Cleanser
avis.texte: This foaming cleanser absolutely washes away all of my makeup without stripping the natural oil from my skin. It's gentle so that after cleansing, my face doesn't feel dry, just clean and soft.
Love the smooth texture, scent and foaming of the product. Leaves your skin feeling clean and soft.

I have been using this cleanser for several years. It deep cleans with a subtle, creamy lather, making my face feel soft and smooth. It has lessened hairline imperfections. I won't use any other product. I'm 66.
I have used this cleaner for years. It is very gentle on your skin and has a nice smell. Easy to use every day.

avis.titre: Love the moisture this product provides.
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and this cleanser is very gently and leaves my skin feeling clean but not dry.
Very impressed with this product , face very soft, remove make up do easily
The product has a pretty good smell, also leaving a good feeling after using it.
Luxurious feel in a cleanser - 2nd step after an oil first step. Love this and feels soo beautiful in how it foams up. Beautiful light rose scent, leaves my sensitive skin soft and supple.
I really like this cleanser. It cleans without drying and doesn't leave a residue.
Nice scent. Foams well. A little goes a long way. Leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh.

I use twice a day and love the way a small amount goes a long way with this cleanser. It takes off makeup easily and leaves skin feeling soft and clean. I follow with the comfort toner, Génifique and then moisturizer.

avis.titre: Works great on my sensitive skin
avis.texte: Love this cleanser. Makes my skin feel smooth. I have very sensitive skin and this cleanser works beautifully for me.

I've used Lancôme since I was in High School 49 years… and this sucks!! You've changed everything every time I use it I break out in hives!! I never did before..,You have changed the formula and NOT for the better!!! I've tried several other products and it's making my face worse!!! I always got comments how great my skin was!! Not now!! Time for me to leave Lancôme!! Totally Ridiculous!!! You've changed skin care and make up… done away with colors!! We stood behind you for years!!! Loyal customers!!! I'm done!!
Smooth and easy to use in your shower! I have sensitive skin and this is the perfect product!

avis.titre: makes my skin feel fabalous soft and clean
avis.texte: Onlyhave to use a small amount for cleansing and does a wonderful job making my skin feel soft and subtle
I love this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. Love the fragrance, too.
Just a small amount creates enough foam to clean the whole face. I will order this again. Love the light rose smell.
I love the rose smell in the morning! Soft and will foam up if you lightly swirl you fingertips in it!
Foams up nicely, rinses well. Skin feels so soft. This is a great cleanser .
Very smooth cleanser! It lathers very nicely. My skin feel so refreshed aftercwadhing.
This cleanser works magic! It cleans, but doesn't dry out my skin. It foams in hard water, and a small drop goes a long way! Highly recommended!
This cleanser is very good and I feel my skin very soft and clean when I used it
Love the smell of this refreshing cleanser. Makes my skin clean and ready for makeup.

This is my favorite Lancome staple. It is gentle on my skin yet cleanses completely. I use it in the morning and evening. My skin tends to be dry and this is not drying at all. My face feels soft after using. I would recommend.
This cleanser leaves my skin feeling soft and smelling so incredibly clean!
I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective way to clean their skin. It's a game-changer and has become a staple in my skincare routine. It's a great foam.
Wow this cleanser is non drying and suds up! I love the creamy foam!
I really love the way this products make my skin feels in the winter, especially with my oily skin
Love the way this makes my face feel been using it for years!
It is very comfortable to use it. I would highly recommend it.
I really like how it foams - but not too much. Some cleansers leave a residue but not this one.
I use this cleanser every night and I like how it makes my face feel!

avis.titre: I'm in love with this cleanser
avis.texte: This cleanser is soft and creamy. It leaves your face feeling clean without drying.

avis.titre: My extra sensitive skin loves this!
avis.texte: My skin can become very red, tight, itchy and blotchy (a.k.a "angry") if I use certain cleansers but it loves this AND it cleans very effectively and gently without drying out my skin. Smells lovely and, unlike other cleansers, a little goes quite a long way. The first time you use it only use about half of what you think you need and you'll be surprised. This is on my "must have" list of essentials.
A little goes a long way. Love the creamy texture leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.
Finally a cleanser tnat doesn't leave my face feeling tight and dry! The smell is light and amazing. I love how foamy it gets amd how it removes makeup.
I love this Lancôme cleanser. My skin is always soft and smooth with the use of this cleanser.
This face wash works really well and it has a very nice feeling on your skin. Added bonus is the rose smell, it is absolutely wonderful! Will definitely continue to repurchase!
I Love this product! It leaves my skin so soft, clean and silky feeling!
I especially love using this creamy cleanser after I've worked out. I like how it suds up and it leaves my skin so soft.
I use this cleanser to pamper my skin. Leaves skin hydrated and soft

I was pleasantly surprised with the beautiful scent and the wonderful feeling that it leaves my skin. A little goes a long way. It feels good on my face and my neck. It cleans gently but efficiently. I will definitely be buying this again.
This is a divine rose foaming cleanser. The smell is gorgeous. It goes a long way. I only use the size of a pea. Pink😀

avis.titre: Love it for my combination skin!
avis.texte: I moved to a dry climate and struggled to find a new face wash to keep my cheeks from getting dry and flaky without my nose and forehead getting oily. This cleanser is it! So creamy, washes off makeup easily and keeps my skin soft and hydrated without getting oily. It smells so fresh too!
I love this cleanser. It's super light but my skin feels so nice and clean. No oily residue and smells wonderful!
I have used other face cleaners and nothing compares to Creme Mousse Confort. My face feels clean and soft.
Best facial wash I've ever used. I have eczema so my skin is very dry. This product cleans without drying out my skin. I love it and now my daughter loves it too!
I'm glad Lancôme put a flip open cap on the tube. The cleanser is great, my skin feels soft. It's gentle on my skin.
As a part of the Hydra Zen regimen, I love the clean feeling you have after using this face wash. It foams just enough and is easy to rinse off.

avis.titre: Only Cleanser I will ever use
avis.texte: Even when I walk into department stores and ask for this cleanser specifically, the beauty consultants rage about it and how popular it is. Years ago, I was skeptical about using a cleanser that didn't "foam" when I came across Crème Mousse Confort Foaming Cleanser. It was referred to me by my esthetician. As a woman in her 40's, I appreciate the hydrating and glowing benefits. Best cleanser ever!

Crème mousse Confort cleanser has been my go to for a year now, and I'm very pleased with how thoroughly, yet gently, it cleans my face. Sometimes my skin runs on the dry side, but in the last year I've experienced no dry patches, itchiness or feelings of discomfort from too tight, dried out skin. I use this cleanser, then follow with Tonique Confort, and my skin is refreshed and ready for moisturizer. The two products have made my skin more supple and soft. Wonderful products.
The product is very effective at keeping the skin soft and I love it.
I got this a sample a while back and have ordered ever since. I love the texture, it's soft and definitely leaves face feeling cleaned. Would recommend.
Removes makeup & makes dry skin feel great. Nice fragrance, too.
It's such a luxurious feel to put on my face after a long day! Plus it works on waterproof makeup as well!
Very happy with the product - leave my skin clean but not dry, very refreshing.
Love this! Nice and creamy and removes makeup well. Just don't like the volume of cream you need to use!
Im really enjoying the Creme Confort. Ive used the Creme Radiance for the longest time and decided to try something else. Creme Confort leaves my skin clean and comfortable.
This is the best cleanser I have ever used. Leave my face clean, but not dry.

avis.titre: Best face cleanser on the market
avis.texte: This face cleanser is one I have used for many years. I have dry skin and this product moisturizes my face like no other. A little dab of the Crème Mousse goes a long way which makes many applications from one tube. The cost is very reasonable compared to other products I have tried. My face feels so soft after washing—I recommend to anyone with dry skin.

avis.titre: Keep my skin clean all year long
avis.texte: I being using this product for years just love it best results easy to use
I love this cleanser. I was battling dry skin, but I wanted something that actually cleaned. This does it! My skin always feels refreshed and clean without stripping it.

avis.titre: The best cleanser for dry skin
avis.texte: So smooth and it cleans so well. Top on that, I got a good deal.
My long time favorite make up remover, does great job every time!
Have been using this for a while. The foaming is nice and it leaves my skin feel clean.
Great product! This does not irritate my skin and leaves my skin feeling smooth and fresh
